390.name: Start screen: six synthetic example cards, New patient, no overflow
Example card opens results with options shown, focus on results, not marked out of date
"N other options" link text reads correctly
Edit inputs returns to the Review step with the entered values
stale handling: an input changed after a run hides the old options; Re-run restores them
New patient from results goes to Start; New patient there opens a blank step 1
Blank Review lists missing core items, offers the run button, and every step is clickable
An invalid value marks its step, is named on Review with a working link, and blocks the run
Walk Next through all seven steps entering a minimal case; focus lands on each step heading
Run from Review: results appear with options or a focused review, focus on results, bar shows entries
Full form and back loses nothing and keeps the results
?view=form loads the original layout and its sample dropdown still works
No page errors or console errors
